comment: Tag vanilla's crushed iron ore as fettle stock, so one recipe slot can take it interchangeably with iwex's recovered oxides (tap cinder, mill scale). Uses tagsByType rather than a top-level tags array because crushed.json is one itemtype covering every ore - crushed galena and cassiterite are not iron oxides and must not fettle. The '*': [] catch-all mirrors vanilla's own powder.json, which tags only '*-borax' as flux the same way; without it the untagged variants have no entry to resolve.
